en.headline: Hong Kong paddlers claim silver and bronze at Asian Para Games
en.dek: Chiu Kan-shan and Wong Yue-ching took silver in women's doubles while Ho Ka-sing and Wong Chi-yin secured bronze in men's doubles in Nagoya on Friday.

zh.headline: 港隊乒乓選手於亞殘運再添銀銅牌
zh.dek: 趙君山與黃宇晴在女子雙打奪銀，何嘉成與黃志賢在男子雙打獲銅，賽事周五在名古屋舉行。

en.headline: Hong Kong records hottest Frost solar term on record at 32.1 degrees
en.dek: The Observatory said the temperature at its headquarters reached 32.1 Celsius by 2.30pm on Friday, breaking the previous mark for the traditional calendar period.

zh.headline: 本港錄得有紀錄以來最熱霜降 天文台總部下午達32.1度
zh.dek: 天文台表示，周五下午2時半總部氣溫達32.1度，打破該節氣的歷史最高紀錄。

en.headline: Observatory maintains Red Fire Danger Warning as risk remains extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6am on Friday, advising the public to take extra fire precautions amid dry conditions.

zh.headline: 天文台維持紅色火災危險警告 火險極高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周五上午6時發出警告，提醒市民在乾燥天氣下特別提高警覺並採取防火措施。

en.headline: Chinalco sets up corporate treasury centre in Hong Kong
en.dek: The state-owned aluminium giant will use the new entity to manage offshore funds, financing and risk, highlighting the city’s role as a hub.

zh.headline: 中鋁集團在港設立企業財資中心
zh.dek: 這家國有鋁業巨頭將透過新實體管理離岸資金、融資及風險，突顯香港作為財資中心樞紐的角色。

en.headline: Security chief says legislative reforms on fire safety are forthcoming
en.dek: Chris Tang told a radio programme that administrative measures already taken would be followed by legislative changes after the Tai Po fire report.

zh.headline: 保安局長指消防安全立法改革即將推出
zh.dek: 鄧炳強在電台節目表示，過去一年已採取行政措施，隨大埔火災報告提交後將有立法改革。

en.headline: More than 70 Hong Kong-Taiwan flights cancelled as Super Typhoon Champi approaches
en.dek: As of Friday afternoon, services by Cathay Pacific, HK Express and others to Taoyuan, Kaohsiung and Taichung have been scrapped, with the storm’s peak impact lasting through the night.

zh.headline: 超強颱風薔琵逼近 逾70班港台航班取消
zh.dek: 截至周五下午，國泰、香港快運等航空公司往返桃園、高雄及台中的航班已取消，風暴高峰影響持續至晚間。

en.headline: Police arrest two women over alleged child abuse after girl's video plea
en.dek: An 11-year-old girl in Wong Tai Sin was found with swollen limbs after posting videos seeking help; her grandmother and a domestic helper have been detained.

zh.headline: 警方黃大仙拘兩女涉虐兒 十一歲女童拍片求救
zh.dek: 一名十一歲女童在社交媒體上載影片求救後，被發現手腳紅腫；其外祖母及一名印尼外傭已被警方拘捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$4.6 million in illicit cigarettes and counterfeits in Sha Tau Kok
en.dek: Officers arrested a 50-year-old saleswoman after raiding a Chung Ying Street shop and finding about 720,000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes plus counterfeit goods.

zh.headline: 海關沙頭角檢獲約460萬元私煙及冒牌貨 拘捕一名女子
zh.dek: 海關周三在中英街一間零售店檢獲約72萬支懷疑私煙及約2700件懷疑冒牌物品，並拘捕一名50歲女售貨員。

en.headline: Citywide Halloween cosplay events continue across five districts this weekend
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s first Halloween Month features street parties in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East on Saturday.

zh.headline: 全城萬聖節Cosplay活動本周末五區繼續舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局首個萬聖節月於中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖東舉行街頭派對，本周六有活動。

en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal as northerly winds strengthen
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the signal at 9:45 a.m. on Friday, warning of strong winds from the north with occasional gale-force gusts.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 預料吹偏北強風
zh.dek: 香港天文台周五上午9時45分發出信號，指本港將吹偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。

en.headline: Sources say Tai Po fire report names four government bodies for accountability
en.dek: The independent committee’s report, submitted on Thursday, is understood to highlight the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit among others, without naming individual officials.

zh.headline: 消息指大埔火災報告點名四個政府部門須負責
zh.dek: 獨立委員會周四提交的報告據悉點名房屋局獨立審查組等四個部門失職，但沒有點名個別官員。

en.headline: Fine and very dry weather expected over the weekend
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory forecasts mainly fine and hot conditions on Saturday and Sunday, with low humidity and light to moderate winds.

zh.headline: 周末天氣天晴及非常乾燥 日間炎熱
zh.dek: 天文台預測周六及周日大致天晴，日間炎熱及乾燥，濕度偏低，風力及後轉弱。

en.headline: Air quality reaches serious levels, experts urge elderly to stay indoors
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department recorded serious and very high health risk levels at several stations amid elevated ozone, with conditions expected to persist for a few more days.

zh.headline: 空氣質素達嚴重水平 專家建議長者留在室內
zh.dek: 環保署多個監測站錄得嚴重及甚高健康風險級別，主因臭氧水平上升，料情況未來數日持續。

en.headline: Customs seizes 8kg of cannabis at airport, two men arrested
en.dek: Two incoming passengers from Bangkok were arrested on Thursday after officers found about 8 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds valued at roughly HK$1.7 million in their luggage.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲8公斤大麻花 兩名男子被捕
zh.dek: 兩名從曼谷抵港的入境乘客周四被截獲，行李內藏約8公斤懷疑大麻花，市值約170萬港元。

en.headline: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin for PayMe users
en.dek: The Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin is rolling out in stages from Friday for more than 3.3 million PayMe users, supporting peer-to-peer and merchant payments.

zh.headline: 滙豐推出RedCoin穩定幣供PayMe用戶使用
zh.dek: 港元穩定幣由周五起分階段向逾330萬名PayMe用戶推出，支援個人對個人及商戶付款。

en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong Monster Mash returns for three Halloween Saturdays
en.dek: The district’s cosplay and street party events run on 17, 24 and 31 October from 7pm to 11pm, with DJs, face painting and roaming performances.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊怪物巡禮夜重臨 三個星期六舉行
zh.dek: 活動於10月17、24及31日晚上7時至11時舉行，設有DJ、化妝及街頭表演。

en.headline: Hong Kong government condemns UK six-monthly report as interference
en.dek: The government said the report contained false and misleading remarks and urged Britain to stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs which are internal matters of China.

zh.headline: 特區政府強烈譴責英國半年報告 斥干預香港事務
zh.dek: 政府指報告內容失實及抹黑，強調《中英聯合聲明》沒有賦予英國干預回歸後香港事務的權利，英國對香港無主權、無治權及無監督權。

en.headline: M+ presents Myths and Monsters survey of Asian fantasy art
en.dek: The exhibition is described as the first major survey exploring two centuries of Asian fantasy visual culture, featuring more than 400 works across fine art, film, fashion and games.

zh.headline: M+呈獻《神話與怪物》亞洲幻想藝術大型展覽
zh.dek: 展覽被形容為首個全面探討兩個世紀亞洲幻想視覺文化的大型調查，展出逾400件跨越純藝術、電影、時裝及遊戲的作品。

en.headline: Centre for Food Safety finds malachite green in imported bluefin tuna sample
en.dek: The sample tested under the routine surveillance programme contained 1.74 parts per billion of the prohibited substance, and the importer has been notified.

zh.headline: 食安中心在進口藍鰕吞拿魚樣本檢出孔雀石綠
zh.dek: 樣本含孔雀石綠1.74十億分率，中心已知會進口商並追查來源及分銷情況。

en.headline: Tertiary student sentenced to 10 years for sexual offences against underage girls
en.dek: High Court Judge Andrew Chan noted the 22-year-old showed no remorse after one 14-year-old victim took her own life following an attempted rape.

zh.headline: 大專生承認性侵未成年少女等12罪 判監10年
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳慶偉指22歲被告范致遠毫無悔意，其中一名14歲受害人遭企圖強奸後輕生。

en.headline: Link Hong Kong Open offers free public admission for opening rounds
en.dek: The 65th edition continues at Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling through Sunday, with free entry on Thursday and Friday and complimentary access for under-18s all week.

zh.headline: 領展香港高爾夫球公開賽首兩日免費開放公眾入場
zh.dek: 第65屆賽事在粉嶺香港哥爾夫球會舉行至周日，周四及周五免費入場，18歲或以下人士全周免費。

en.headline: MTR to offer half-fare travel on Thank You Day this Saturday
en.dek: Passengers using Octopus, JoyYou Card or QR codes on most of the network, including East Rail Line border crossings, will pay half fare on 24 October.

zh.headline: 港鐵本周六感謝日提供半價乘車
zh.dek: 乘客使用八達通、樂悠咗或二維碼乘搭大部分網絡，包括東鐵綫過境車程，24日可享半價車費。

en.headline: Digital Policy Office urges immediate patches for critical PHP vulnerabilities
en.dek: The office issued a security alert to government departments and public organisations after two critical flaws in the widely used web language were disclosed.

zh.headline: 數字辦呼籲即時修補PHP嚴重安全漏洞
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室向政府部門及公營機構發出保安警報，要求全面檢視系統並盡快完成修補。

en.headline: Authorities say missing lift fire door frames confined to Taizoom
en.dek: Inspections found no similar omissions among other contractors after 338 buildings serviced by Taizoom Elevator were confirmed to lack the components.

zh.headline: 機電署指升降機缺失防火門框僅限臺日電梯
zh.dek: 當局表示，除臺日電梯外，其他承辦商維修的升降機未發現同類缺失防火門框組件的情況。

en.headline: Chan Yui-lam takes Hong Kong’s second gold at Asian Para Games
en.dek: The swimmer won the women’s 100 metres butterfly S14 in 1 minute 5.19 seconds, with teammate Lau Chiu-kee claiming bronze.

zh.headline: 亞殘運陳睿琳女子蝶泳奪金 港隊再添金牌
zh.dek: 她以1分05.19秒勝出女子S14級100米蝶泳，隊友劉肖儀得銅牌，是港隊本屆第二面金牌。

en.headline: Chow Tai Fook expects interim profit to rise 90 to 100 percent
en.dek: The jewellery group attributed the increase mainly to fair value gains on gold loan contracts and improved sales in core markets.

zh.headline: 周大福發盈喜 料中期盈利升約九成至一倍
zh.dek: 集團指升幅主要來自黃金貸款合約重估帶來的公允價值收益，以及核心市場銷售改善。

en.headline: OASES welcomes seventh batch of 18 strategic enterprises
en.dek: The firms are expected to add to a cumulative HK$84 billion in investment and about 27,000 jobs from 142 strategic partners to date.

zh.headline: 引進辦公布第七批18家重點企業
zh.dek: 連同過往批次，142家重點企業預計帶來約840億港元投資及約2.7萬個職位。

en.headline: Hong Kong adds silver and three bronze medals in para table tennis
en.dek: Lam Yan-yu and Wong Hon-lam took silver in mixed doubles XD20, while three other pairs secured bronze after losing in the semi-finals.

zh.headline: 亞殘運乒乓球港隊奪一銀三銅
zh.dek: 林恩羽與黃瀚林混合雙打XD20級得銀牌，另三對組合在四強失利後獲銅牌。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 3.03 percent lower at 22934.68
en.dek: The benchmark fell 717 points as the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 5.03 percent, with Alibaba, Meituan and Xiaomi among the heaviest blue-chip losers.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收報22934.68點 全日跌3.03%
zh.dek: 恒指收跌717點，恒生科技指數挫5.03%，阿里巴巴、美團及小米等藍籌科技股領跌。

en.headline: September inflation rises to 1.9 percent, underlying rate at 2.1 percent
en.dek: The Composite CPI increased more than in August, driven mainly by faster rises in transport fares and package tour charges, the Census and Statistics Department said.

zh.headline: 9月綜合消費物價指數按年升1.9% 基本通脹率2.1%
zh.dek: 升幅較8月擴大，主要因進出香港交通費及套裝旅遊費用升幅加快，統計處公布。

en.headline: Unemployment rate rises to 3.9 percent in July to September
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted rate edged up 0.1 percentage point from the previous three-month period, with underemployment also rising to 2.0 percent.

zh.headline: 7至9月失業率升至3.9% 就業不足率升至2%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率較前一三個月期微升0.1個百分點，失業人數增至15.5萬人。

en.headline: HK Express cancels 10 Taiwan flights on Friday as Typhoon Champi approaches
en.dek: The budget carrier will scrap six Hong Kong–Taipei services and cancel or defer others to Taichung and Kaohsiung, offering free rebooking or refunds to affected passengers.

zh.headline: 香港快運周五取消10班台灣航班 因超強颱風薔琵逼近
zh.dek: 快運宣布取消六班往返台北航班，另有台中及高雄航班取消或改期至周六，受影響旅客可免費改期或退款。

en.headline: Buildings Department applies tighter national standard for scaffold safety nets
en.dek: From 1 September, contractors must test nets manufactured under GB 5725-2025, which sets a two-second limit on afterflame and afterglow for dip-coated nets.

zh.headline: 屋宇署採用更嚴格棚網國標 浸漬塗覆網阻燃要求收緊至兩秒
zh.dek: 自9月1日起，承建商須按GB 5725-2025新標準測試新製棚網，浸漬塗覆網的續燃及陰燃時間上限由四秒收緊至兩秒。

en.headline: Nine injured as two KMB double-deckers collide in Tuen Mun
en.dek: A route 258D bus struck the rear of a route 66M bus near Shan King Estate on Ming Kum Road shortly after 8am, with both drivers among the casualties.

zh.headline: 屯門兩九巴相撞九人受傷
zh.dek: 早上約8時15分，258D線紅色九巴在鳴琴路山景邨對開撞向停在燈位的66M線金色九巴車尾，兩名車長在內共九人輕傷。

en.headline: Health official warns of longer flu season as child vaccination rates fall
en.dek: Edwin Tsui said more than 900,000 doses have been given this season, about 10 percent fewer than the same period last year, with rates down across age groups.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心總監警告流感季或較去年長 兒童接種率下跌
zh.dek: 徐樂堅指接種計劃至今已打逾90萬劑，較去年同期少約一成，各年齡組別接種率均下降。

en.headline: Wild boar captured in Victoria Park after morning sighting
en.dek: Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff used a tranquiliser dart to remove the one-metre animal from the Causeway Bay park after police secured the area.

zh.headline: 維多利亞公園野豬出沒 漁護署施麻醉槍後運走
zh.dek: 今早約7時一頭約1米長野豬闖入銅鑼灣維園，警方持盾戒備，漁農自然護理署人員於上午用麻醉槍將其捕獲運走。

en.headline: Man arrested over alleged indecent exposure to five schoolgirls in Yau Tong
en.dek: Police detained a 26-year-old man after two incidents involving secondary school students near a playground and estate in the district.

zh.headline: 油塘26歲男涉向五名女學生露體被捕
zh.dek: 警方拘捕一名26歲男子，涉兩度在鯉魚門道遊樂場及油麗邨附近向中學女學生暴露臀部。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index drops more than 600 points by midday
en.dek: The benchmark fell below 23,000 points in the morning session as technology and financial shares weighed on the market.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌逾600點失守23000點
zh.dek: 港股周四上午重挫，科技及金融股拖累，恒指半日報約22972點，較上日收市跌近680點。

en.headline: Independent committee submits Tai Po fire report to Chief Executive
en.dek: The judge-led panel delivered its two-volume findings on the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people, with John Lee pledging swift reforms and accountability.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會向特首提交報告
zh.dek: 法官領導的委員會周四早上把報告交予李家超，特首表示短期內公布全面改革及追究責任，公開版本須先經法律審視。

en.headline: Police to hold highest honour funeral for senior officer Zhu Chun-kwok
en.dek: The force will conduct the ceremony on Friday for the officer who was stabbed while on duty in 2005 and died in September after 21 years.

zh.headline: 警務處周五為朱振國舉行最高榮譽喪禮
zh.dek: 2005年執勤遭割頸後臥床21年的高級警員朱振國9月離世，警隊周五於紅磡世界殯儀館舉行最高規格喪禮，其後安葬浩園。

en.headline: Peng Kanglong ink exhibition begins second rotation at Tai Kwun
en.dek: INKstudio’s solo show of nearly 40 works by the contemporary ink artist runs its second rotation from today until 28 November.

zh.headline: 彭康隆水墨個展第二階段於大館墨齋展開
zh.dek: 近40件作品的個展「迷路只為看花開」第二輪替今日起至11月28日於中環大館展出。

en.headline: Receivers sell Shimao’s Tung Chung hotels for HK$2.7 billion
en.dek: The Sheraton and Four Points by Sheraton complex on Lantau, with 1,219 rooms, is sold to a buyer linked to Malaysian developer ParkCity.

zh.headline: 世茂東涌喜來登酒店銀主盤以27億元出售
zh.dek: 大嶼山雙品牌酒店共1,219間客房，售予與馬來西亞發展商ParkCity有關的買家，預計年底前完成。

en.headline: Health officials warn of risks from cadaver-derived beauty injections after raids
en.dek: The Department of Health seized unregistered Elravie Re2O products that claim to contain human tissue and arrested a woman, citing lack of clinical safety data.

zh.headline: 衞生署警告屍皮針有公共衞生風險 突擊搜查後拘捕女子
zh.dek: 署方在四間美容處所檢獲未經註冊的Elravie Re2O針劑，聲稱含人類組織，並指產品缺乏臨床安全數據。

en.headline: Ocean Park’s Halloween Fest continues with night-time haunted experiences through early…
en.dek: The Grave Rave season includes Under the Castle and other attractions on designated evenings until 1 November, according to the park.

zh.headline: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭持續 指定晚間驚嚇體驗至11月1日
zh.dek: 主題「詭魅墓會」日間活動每日開放至11月1日，夜間鬼屋等體驗於指定日子舉行。

en.headline: Christie’s opens commemorative show of 1935 Chinese art exhibition
en.dek: Nearly 15 masterpieces that appeared in the landmark Royal Academy display are on view at The Henderson in Central until 6 November.

zh.headline: 佳士得展開1935年中國藝術展覽紀念展
zh.dek: 近15件曾於倫敦皇家藝術學院展出的精品，即日起至11月6日於中環The Henderson公開展出。

en.headline: Hong Kong schools weigh Paris iGEM trip amid France travel alert
en.dek: More than 30 schools and nearly 600 students and teachers had planned to attend the synthetic-biology competition next month; the Education Bureau says safety is the priority.

zh.headline: 港校評估巴黎iGEM行程 教育局強調學生安全優先
zh.dek: 逾30間中學及大學、近600名師生原定下月赴巴黎參賽，政府已對法國發出黃色外遊警示，校方正重新評估。

en.headline: Hong Kong holds 24th place in 2026 global Rule of Law Index
en.dek: The World Justice Project ranks the city sixth in East Asia and the Pacific, with order and security rising to seventh worldwide, the Department of Justice said.

zh.headline: 香港法治指數維持全球第24位 秩序與安全升至第7
zh.dek: 世界正義工程公布2026年指數，香港在東亞及太平洋區排第6，律政司指廉潔及秩序安全仍居全球十大。

en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum continues at Kai Tak through late November
en.dek: The Swedish exhibition at AIRSIDE’s GATE33 Gallery displays more than 80 unusual foods from 35 countries and includes a tasting bar for visitors who want to try them.

zh.headline: 嘔心食物博物館啟德展期至11月底
zh.dek: 瑞典展覽在啟德AIRSIDE GATE33藝文館展出超過80款來自35個國家的奇特食物，並設試食吧供參觀者挑戰。

en.headline: Hong Kong Airlines cancels two Okinawa flights today as Typhoon Champi nears
en.dek: The carrier has axed HX658 and HX659 between Hong Kong and Okinawa on Thursday and warned that Taipei services may face delays or cancellations through Saturday.

zh.headline: 港航取消今日兩班沖繩航班 薔琶影響台北航線或受阻
zh.dek: 香港航空宣布取消周四往返香港與沖繩的HX658及HX659，並指明日起至周六往返台北航班可能延誤或取消。

en.headline: Journalists raise concerns as government tightens media access to land records
en.dek: Subsidiary legislation tabled at the Legislative Council would require journalists to apply for searches on public-interest grounds, with the Land Registrar deciding case by case.

zh.headline: 政府收緊土地查冊安排 傳媒及議員表示關注
zh.dek: 相關附屬法例已提交立法會先訂立後審議，傳媒若以公眾利益為由查冊須個別申請，由土地註冊處處長考慮。

en.headline: Independent committee set to submit Tai Po fire report to government today
en.dek: Sources said the judge-led panel investigating the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people will deliver its findings on Thursday, with a redacted version expected later.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑大火調查委員會料今日提交報告
zh.dek: 消息指法官領導的委員會將於周四把報告交予政府，經遮蓋後的版本最早下星期公開。

en.headline: Dry northeast monsoon keeps Thursday hot and mainly fine
en.dek: Overnight cloud and isolated rain give way to hot, dry conditions with urban highs around 32 degrees as Super Typhoon Champi stays far to the southeast.

zh.headline: 乾燥東北季候風持續 星期四炎熱大致天晴
zh.dek: 晚間部分時間多雲有一兩陣雨，日間轉為炎熱乾燥，市區最高氣溫約32度，超強颱風薔琵仍遠離本港。

en.headline: 13th Hong Kong Food Carnival opens Saturday with 330 stalls
en.dek: The nine-day event at Kwai Chung Sports Ground runs from 24 October to 1 November, adding a Southeast Asian zone and Beyblade battles alongside $6 entry and evening free admission.

zh.headline: 第13屆香港美食嘉年華星期六葵涌開幕
zh.dek: 一連九日設逾330個攤位，新增東南亞美食區及爆旋陀螺街霸戰，入場費6元，晚上7時起免費。

en.headline: Unvaccinated 12-year-old girl becomes second child flu death this season
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the girl died on Tuesday after developing influenza A complications, and urged the public to get vaccinated promptly.

zh.headline: 12歲未接種疫苗女童染甲流不治 成今季第二宗兒童死亡個案
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心指女童周二不治，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克等，呼籲市民盡快接種疫苗。

en.headline: Two media outlets receive suspicious letters containing white powder from UK
en.dek: Police and specialist teams responded after staff at HK01 and Ta Kung Wen Wei Media Group found powder believed to be crushed oatmeal in airmail letters.

zh.headline: 兩傳媒機構同日收英國寄出白色粉末信 警展開調查
zh.dek: 《香港01》葵涌辦公室及大公文匯傳媒集團香港仔辦事處先後接獲內藏粉末的空郵信件，警方派員到場處理。

en.headline: Police arrest four teenagers over viral Sai Wan Ho alley assault video
en.dek: Officers held four local boys aged 13 to 17 after footage showed a younger boy being punched and slapped in a back alley early Monday.

zh.headline: 西灣河後巷童黨欺凌片 警拘4名13至17歲男童
zh.dek: 警方表示，網上片段顯示一名男童周一凌晨約3時在西灣河後巷疑遭掌掰及推倒，東區警區隨後拘4名本地男童。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns to harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s four-day event at Central Harbourfront and Tamar Park will feature more than 340 booths from about 31 countries and regions.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餐巡禮10月29日起於中環海濱舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日活動設逾340個攤位，匯聚約31個國家及地區的美酒美食，周五六開放至凌晨1時。

en.headline: 16 contractors rated poor or very poor on site safety from 2021 to 2025
en.dek: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn told the Legislative Council that one contractor was rated poor and 15 very poor in quarterly reports, with 2023 seeing the highest number.

zh.headline: 2021至2025年有16間承建商工地安全被評欠佳或極差
zh.dek: 發展局局長甫漢豪書面回覆立法會，指過去五年有一間承建商評為欠佳、十五間極差，2023年極差數目最多。

en.headline: SHKP sells all 128 Sierra Sea flats offered in latest price list
en.dek: Agents said the New Territories project in Shap Sze Heung found buyers for the full batch by late afternoon on Wednesday, with units priced from about $5.47 million after discounts.

zh.headline: 新地西沙SIERRA SEA最新價單128伙全數沽清
zh.dek: 代理指，十四鄉項目周三下午展開銷售，傍晚前全數售出，折實售價由約547萬至987萬元。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 0.9 percent lower at 23,651 after early gains reverse
en.dek: The benchmark opened higher following Wall Street gains but ended Wednesday down 216 points, with the tech index also falling and CATL leading declines after results.

zh.headline: 恒指收跌216點報23651 早段升幅全數回吐
zh.dek: 港股周三高開後轉跌，科技指數同步向下，寧德時代績後急挫逾一成，成交活躍。

en.headline: Police record more than 50 investment scams in a week, total losses exceed $30 million
en.dek: A woman in her 60s lost over $4.5 million after buying cryptocurrency through a fraudster she met on a property platform who posed as an investment expert.

zh.headline: 過去一周逾50宗投資騙案 總損失逾三千萬 六旬婦失450萬
zh.dek: 一名退休婦人在物業平台認識假冒投資專家的騙徒，多次購買泰達幣轉帳後損失超過450萬港元。

en.headline: Executive Council approves moderated Star Ferry fare rise from January 2027
en.dek: Weekday adult fares on the Central and Wan Chai to Tsim Sha Tsui routes will rise by 60 cents to $1, with weekend increases of $1 to $1.80; the monthly ticket stays at $190.

zh.headline: 行會批准天星小輪加價 明年一月生效 平日加0.6至1元
zh.dek: 中環及灣仔往返尖沙咀兩條航線平日成人票上限調至6元、周末8.3元，月票維持190元不變。

en.headline: Liu Huiyin takes Hong Kong’s first gold of the Asian Para Games in boccia
en.dek: She defeated teammate Zhang Yuan 7-2 in the women’s BC4 final, securing gold and silver for the SAR as the team added more medals on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 劉慧茵奪亞殘運港隊首金 硬地滾球女子BC4擊敗張沅
zh.dek: 她在決賽以7比2擊敗隊友張沅，為港隊包辦該項目金銀牌，同日硬地滾球隊再添多面獎牌。

en.headline: Man arrested after trying to open bank account with fake $1,000 notes in Central
en.dek: Police said a man in his 70s from the mainland was held after bank staff in IFC Tower 2 spotted seven suspected counterfeit notes around midday on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 中環國金男子持7張偽千元鈔開戶被捕
zh.dek: 警方指一名約70歲內地男子周三中午在國際金融中心二期銀行被揭發，職員發現鈔票質感有異後報警。

en.headline: 48 Direct Subsidy Scheme schools approved for expansion, 170 non-local students enrolled
en.dek: The Education Bureau said the number of self-financed non-local students on student visas is up 13% this year, describing the pilot as off to a good start.

zh.headline: 48間直資學校獲批擴容 本學年170名非本地生入讀
zh.dek: 教育局指持學生簽證以自資模式入讀的非本地生較去年增13%，形容試點計劃開局良好。

en.headline: Work on Peak trail lighting project suspended amid environmental concerns
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s installations along Lugard and Harlech Roads have stopped, with the project’s future uncertain after complaints about damage to trees and the hillside.

zh.headline: 山頂步行徑燈影項目工程暫停 環境關注升溫
zh.dek: 旅發局在盧吉道及夏力道的燈光裝置工程已停止，項目未來未明，市民憂慮損樹及破壞山徑環境。

en.headline: APEC finance ministers agree to strengthen policy coordination
en.dek: The two-day meeting in Hong Kong wrapped up with a joint statement and a policy paper on digital infrastructure financing, according to Chinese Finance Minister Lan Foan.

zh.headline: APEC財長會議結束 同意加強宏觀政策協調
zh.dek: 會議周三在香港閉幕，中國財政部部長藍佛安表示成員同意加強宏觀經濟溝通協調，並發表聯合聲明及數字基礎設施融資政策文件。

en.headline: Fire Services clarifies it never requests advance payments for supplies
en.dek: The department issued a statement after reports of a fraudster posing as an officer who asked a clinic to pay a deposit for electric wheelchairs.

zh.headline: 消防處澄清絕不會要求商戶墊支代購物品
zh.dek: 部門周三發聲明，指有騙徒假冒消防人員向物理治療診所要求墊付電動輪椅訂金，處方強調絕無此事。

en.headline: Only 3% of Hong Kong firms fully integrate AI into workflows, survey finds
en.dek: Accenture polled 150 companies and released results on Wednesday, finding strong interest but hurdles including resistance to change and outdated infrastructure.

zh.headline: 調查指僅3%港企將人工智能全面融入工作流程
zh.dek: 埃森哲周三公布對150家企業的調查結果，指企業有強烈採用意欲，但面臨組織變革阻力及數碼基建過時等障礙。

en.headline: SAR boccia athletes set up all-Hong Kong women's BC4 final
en.dek: Cheung Yuen and Vivian Lau both advanced on Wednesday morning, guaranteeing Hong Kong gold and silver in the event at the Asian Para Games.

zh.headline: 港隊女子BC4硬地滾球決賽全港對決
zh.dek: 張苑及劉詠嫻周三上午先後晉級，確保港隊在亞殘運會該項目奪得金銀牌。

en.headline: Catering labour import applications drop under tighter vetting rules
en.dek: Labour Department figures show 93 applications failed the new manning ratio since June, while completed cases in September mostly finished within four months.

zh.headline: 餐飲業輸入勞工申請在收緊審批後減少
zh.dek: 勞工處數據顯示，自六月起有93宗申請因未能符合人手比例而被拒，九月完成審批的個案大部分在四個月內處理完畢。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index opens 1.14% higher at 24,139
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rose at the open on Wednesday following gains on Wall Street, with the benchmark topping 24,000 points.

zh.headline: 恒生指數高開271點報24139
zh.dek: 港股周三高開，跟隨美股升勢，基準指數重上24000點。

en.headline: Hong Kong Food Carnival opens Saturday at Kwai Chung Sports Ground
en.dek: The 13th edition runs 24 October to 1 November with more than 330 booths, a new Southeast Asian food zone and a Beyblade tournament.

zh.headline: 第13屆香港美食嘉年華周六葵涌運動場開幕
zh.dek: 活動由10月24日至11月1日舉行，設逾330個攤位、全新東南亞美食區及爆旋陀螺賽事。

en.headline: Halloween installations light up Statue Square Gardens through end of October
en.dek: Hongkong Land’s free display at Statue Square Gardens South runs nightly until 31 October, with a family day scheduled on Chater Road this Saturday.

zh.headline: 皇后像廣場花園萬聖節裝置亮燈至月底
zh.dek: 置地公司在皇后像廣場花園南設免費裝置，每晚亮燈至10月31日，本周六遮打道將舉辦家庭日活動。

en.headline: Three vehicles collide inside Aberdeen Tunnel, no injuries
en.dek: A coach and two private cars were involved in the Wan Chai-bound tube around 8 a.m.; one car was badly damaged and a lane was briefly closed.

zh.headline: 香港仔隧道三車相撞 無人受傷
zh.dek: 早上近8時，往灣仔方向管道內兩架私家車相撞後再撞旅遊巴，一車嚴重損毀，慢線一度封閉。

en.headline: Box truck overturns after hitting barrier in San Po Kong, driver injured
en.dek: The vehicle struck an impact-absorbing barrier near Rhythm Garden around 4 a.m. on Prince Edward Road East; the driver climbed out with head and limb injuries.

zh.headline: 新蒲崗貨車撞欄翻側 司機受傷
zh.dek: 凌晨約4時，太子道東往觀塘方向近采頤花園，貨車失控撞風琴式防撞欄後翻側，司機頭部及手腳受傷清醒送院。

en.headline: Woman dies after falling from Tin Shui Wai public housing block
en.dek: A woman was found on the pavement outside Shengzhen House at Tin Shing Court around 8 a.m.; ambulance crews confirmed she had died at the scene.

zh.headline: 天水圍天盛苑女子墮樓 當場死亡
zh.dek: 早上約8時07分，天盛苑盛珍閣一名女子墮樓，倒臥大廈對開行人路上，救護員到場證實已死亡。

en.headline: Dump truck collides with lorry on Yuen Long Highway, driver injured
en.dek: The collision near Fuk Hang Tsuen around 9:20 a.m. left the lorry driver briefly trapped; some lanes towards Yuen Long remain closed.

zh.headline: 元朗公路泥頭車與貨車相撞 司機受傷
zh.dek: 早上約9時20分，往元朗方向近福亨村發生碰撞，貨車司機一度被困，部分行車線仍然封閉。

en.headline: 14-year-old arrested after child’s bicycle set alight in Kwai Fong Estate
en.dek: Police found the boy nearby with burns to his face and forearm after a security guard extinguished the fire at a podium garden opposite Kwai Shun House late on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 葵芳邨小童單車遭縱火 14歲少年面部及前臂燒傷被捕
zh.dek: 周二晚上約11時19分，葵信樓對開停車場平台花園有小童單車起火，保安員撲熄後報警，警方其後拘捕一名14歲少年。

en.headline: CityUHK’s Power of Play exhibition on gaming history closes this weekend
en.dek: The free interactive show at the Indra and Harry Banga Gallery runs until 25 October, tracing 5,000 years of play from ancient board games to modern esports.

zh.headline: 城大《游於藝乎》遊戲史展覽本周末閉幕
zh.dek: 般哥展覽館免費互動展至10月25日止，追溯五千年遊戲文化，從古埃及桌遊到現代電競。

en.headline: Police arrest four boys over Sai Wan Ho alley assault video
en.dek: Eastern district officers detained four local boys aged 13 to 17 on suspicion of assault occasioning actual bodily harm and inciting others to join an illegal society.

zh.headline: 西灣河後巷毆人影片 警方拘捕四名13至17歲男童
zh.dek: 東區警區拘捕四名本地男童，涉嫌襲擊致造成身體傷害及煽惑他人成為非法社團成員。

en.headline: Man dies after being rescued from sea near Ting Kau Bridge
en.dek: Tsing Ma control area staff found an empty seven-seater on the hard shoulder towards Tuen Mun around 1 a.m.; marine police later pulled a 35-year-old man from the water.

zh.headline: 汀九橋男子疑墮海 水警救起後證實不治
zh.dek: 青馬管制區職員約凌晨1時發現往屯門方向路肩有無人七人車，水警其後在附近海面救起35歲男子。

en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning as temperatures climb
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6:45 a.m., forecasting urban highs around 33 degrees and extremely hot conditions in some New Territories areas.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告 市民慎防中暑
zh.dek: 天文台於早上6時45分發出警告，預料市區最高約33度，新界部分地區更熱，局部極端酷熱。

en.headline: Health officials raid beauty premises and seize unregistered injections
en.dek: Department of Health seized more than 100 vials of suspected Part 1 poisons and 20 vials of a product claiming to contain human tissue; a woman was arrested.

zh.headline: 衞生署突擊搜查美容院檢獲未註冊針劑 女子被捕
zh.dek: 衞生署檢獲逾100支懷疑第1部毒藥針劑及20支聲稱含人類組織的產品；一名38歲女子因涉嫌非法管有及人體器官交易被捕。

en.headline: Happy Wednesday Oktoberfest and Beerfest continues at Happy Valley tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s midweek racing night at Happy Valley Racecourse features Bavarian-themed entertainment on 7, 14 and 21 October.

zh.headline: 快活谷快樂星期三Oktoberfest及Beerfest今晚繼續
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會於快活谷馬場的周三賽馬夜，在十月七日、十四日及二十一日舉行巴伐利亞主題活動。

en.headline: Loop Hong Kong Park second land tender draws nine bids
en.dek: The operator said frontier technology firms and major conglomerates submitted offers for three laboratory and office parcels in the first phase.

zh.headline: 河套香港園區第二批土地招標接獲九份標書
zh.dek: 園區公司表示，投標者包括前沿科技企業及大型綜合企業，涉及三幅主要作實驗室及辦公室用途的第一期地塊。

en.headline: Man injured in suspected knife attack near Tuen Mun convenience store
en.dek: Police found a 61-year-old man with abdomen and hand injuries outside a store on Yan Oi Tong Circuit; a fruit knife was recovered and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 屯門便利店附近男子疑遭刀襲受傷
zh.dek: 警方在仁愛堂街便利店外發現61歲男子腹部及手部受傷，現場檢獲水果刀，暫無人被捕。

en.headline: Fire at Wong Chuk Hang temple suspected caused by incense
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Tai Wong Ye Temple on Nam Long Shan Road in about 10 minutes; no one was injured.

zh.headline: 黃竹坑大王爺廟起火 懷疑香火誤燒鐵架
zh.dek: 消防約10分鐘撲熄南朗山道大王爺廟火警，無人受傷。

en.headline: St Stephen’s Society exhibition on Kowloon Walled City stories closes today at Central…
en.dek: The multimedia show featuring artwork by residents of the charity and founder Jackie Pullinger’s decades of work runs until tonight on the first floor of Central Market.

zh.headline: 聖士提芬會「285個家」展覽今日於中環街市閉幕
zh.dek: 展覽展出受助居民作品及創辦人白嘉玲（Jackie Pullinger）逾五十年服務香港的故事，即日至今晚十時於中環街市一樓舉行。

en.headline: Report finds average sentences for child sex offences remain well below maximum
en.dek: University of Hong Kong research analysing 401 judgments from 1990 to 2025 found average prison terms for the gravest child sex crimes ranged from under five to under ten years.

zh.headline: 研究指涉兒童性罪行平均判刑遠低於最高刑罰
zh.dek: 港大法律學院分析1990至2025年401份判決，發現最嚴重兒童性罪行平均判刑介乎四年半至不足十年，遠低於終身監禁的法定最高刑。

en.headline: Hong Kong airport passenger traffic rises 10.2 per cent in September
en.dek: Hong Kong International Airport handled 4.86 million passengers last month, driven by transfer traffic, and received three best-airport awards.

zh.headline: 香港國際機場九月客運量按年升百分之十點二
zh.dek: 機場管理局周二公布，九月處理486萬人次旅客，按年升百分之十點二，主要由轉機旅客帶動，並獲三項最佳機場殊榮。

en.headline: IOMed settles Malaysian infrastructure dispute on first anniversary
en.dek: The Hong Kong-based International Organisation for Mediation resolved a construction dispute in Malaysia on Tuesday, its second successful case since launching operations.

zh.headline: 國際調解院成立一周年 成功調解馬來西亞基建爭議
zh.dek: 總部設於香港的國際調解院周二成功調解一宗馬來西亞基建爭議，為機構自運作以來第二宗成功個案。

en.headline: Tai Po fire inquiry report to be submitted to government on Thursday
en.dek: Sources say the independent committee investigating the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people will deliver its final report on Thursday, with a redacted public version expected next week.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑大火調查報告周四交政府
zh.dek: 消息指調查委員會將於周四向政府提交最終報告，涉及168人死亡的火災，公開版本最早下周發布，部分內容或因刑事調查而被遮蔽。

en.headline: China Mobile first three quarters profit falls nearly 8 per cent
en.dek: The company reported operating revenue of 780.3 billion yuan, down 1.8 per cent, and profit attributable to shareholders of 106.2 billion yuan for the nine months to 30 September.

zh.headline: 中國移動首三季盈利跌近八成
zh.dek: 公司公佈截至九月底止九個月，營運收入七千八百零三億元人民幣，按年跌百分之一點八；股東應佔利潤一千零六十二億元人民幣，按年跌百分之七點九。

en.headline: Election Committee nomination period ends with 1,155 forms received
en.dek: Returning officers received 1,115 candidate nomination forms and 40 from designated bodies by the 5pm close on Tuesday, with 31 of 36 elected subsectors set for contests on 22 November.

zh.headline: 選舉委員會提名期結束 共接獲十一百五十五份表格
zh.dek: 提名期周二下午五時結束，選舉主任累計接獲一千一百一十五份候選人提名表格及四十份指定團體提名，三十一個界別分組將於十一月二十二日進行選舉。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index falls 1.3 per cent to close at 23,867
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks joined a regional retreat on Tuesday after Beijing left key lending rates unchanged and stronger mainland GDP data reduced expectations for further stimulus.

zh.headline: 恆生指數跌百分之一點三 收報二萬三千八百六十七點
zh.dek: 周二港股隨區域市場回落，內地維持貸款利率不變及較強經濟數據令市場對進一步刺激預期降溫。

en.headline: John Lee addresses International Mediation Court on its first anniversary
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the court had quickly become a trusted intergovernmental body and outlined measures in the Policy Address to position Hong Kong as a global mediation centre.

zh.headline: 李家超出席國際調解院成立一周年慶祝活動
zh.dek: 行政長官指國際調解院迅速成為獲信賴的政府間機構，並重申施政報告中支援及合作措施，推動香港成為全球調解中心。

en.headline: Government issues yellow travel alert for France amid ongoing protests
en.dek: The Security Bureau raised a yellow alert for France on Tuesday, citing continued demonstrations that have led to violent clashes and damage, and advised Hong Kong residents to avoid crowds and protest areas.

zh.headline: 港府對法國發出黃色外遊警示 呼籲港人避開示威區域
zh.dek: 鉴於法國多地持續示威造成暴力衝突及破壞，特區政府周二對法國發出黃色外遊警示，呼籲港人提高警覺並避開人群聚集地方。

en.headline: School bus rear-ends KMB double-decker on New Clear Water Bay Road, eight injured
en.dek: A school bus carrying students collided with the rear of a 290A bus near Choi Wan Estate around 4pm on Tuesday, leaving eight people with minor injuries including two pupils.

zh.headline: 新清水灣道校巴落斜撞九巴車尾 八人受輕傷包括兩學童
zh.dek: 週二下午約4時，一輛接載學童的校巴在彩雲邨對開往黃大仙方向疑收刾不及，撞向停駐的290A線九巴車尾，造成八人輕傷，包括兩名小學生。

en.headline: Paul Chan warns geopolitical uncertainty poses downside risks at APEC meeting
en.dek: Hong Kong’s financial secretary told APEC finance ministers that while Asia’s growth is outpacing the world, concentration in AI-related assets and geopolitical disruptions require fiscal prudence and closer cooperation.

zh.headline: 陳茂波APEC財長會警告地緣政治不確定性帶來下行風險
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波周二在香港舉行的APEC財長會議上指，亞太增長領先全球，但地緣政治不確定性及過度集中於AI相關資產或放大市場修正，需要財政審慎及更緊密合作。

en.headline: SAR women's foil team claims silver at Asian Para Games
en.dek: Hong Kong’s squad finished second after a 12-30 loss to the national team in Nagoya on Tuesday under the new 30-point format.

zh.headline: 香港女子花劍隊亞殘運會奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊周二在名古屋以12比30不敵國家隊，在新賽制下取得銀牌。

en.headline: Jiao Jinshan takes silver in women's class 7 singles at Asian Para Games
en.dek: The Hong Kong paddler lost 2-3 to Wang Rui of the national team in the final after winning two games to level the match.

zh.headline: 焦瑾珊亞殘運女子7級單打奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊球手周二決賽以2比3不敵國家隊王睿，在多局拉鋸後取得銀牌。

en.headline: Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge half marathon draws record 10,000 entries
en.dek: The November 15 race has been upgraded to World Athletics Platinum status, the first such road race in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋半馬拉松逾萬人報名破紀錄
zh.dek: 11月15日賽事升格世界田徑聯會白金級，為本港首個獲此認證的馬拉松。

en.headline: Suzhou Dongshan seeks up to US$1.36 billion in Hong Kong IPO
en.dek: The circuit board maker’s offering trails earlier expectations amid concerns over potential US trade restrictions on its optical modules business.

zh.headline: 東山精密計劃在港招股集資最多13.6億美元
zh.dek: 印刷電路板製造商發售規模低於早前預期，市場憂慮其光模塊業務或受美國貿易限制影響。
